title: AI Agents with .NET Libraries
description: Build agents that plan, use tools, and act on backend systems using Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and related libraries.
longDescription: Agents combine retrieval, reasoning, and action. This module explores agent architectures, planner patterns, memory, tool use, and human-in-the-loop flows using Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and Microsoft.Extensions.AI with tool calling.
whatYouLearn: Choose an agent architecture for a given backend problem
Implement planners and tool-calling loops in Semantic Kernel
Use AutoGen for multi-agent conversation patterns in .NET
Manage memory and avoid context-window failures
Add approval gates, validation, and observability to agents
Build multi-step agent pipelines with the SK Process Framework
Create structured tools with AIFunctionFactory and JsonSchema
